American University scholarships for international students, 2026-27

International scholarships, fellowships or grants are offered to students outside the country where the university is located. These are also called as financial aid and many times the financial aid office of the American University deals with it. American University scholarships are offered by American University to study or research there.

There are various American University scholarships for international students. Apart from the university-based scholarships, there are many other organizations including foundations, trusts, corporates etc. Who offer scholarships for international students. To help, we list out the latest international scholarships, fellowships and grants information. The American University scholarships application form is also available to apply online for the scholarships.

Quick links for American University scholarships:

  • American University Bachelors scholarships (also known as American University undergraduate scholarships)
  • American University Masters scholarships
  • American University PhD scholarships

As you see, these American University scholarships can be taken for various degree levels. Explore American University courses/ degree programs offered for American University bachelors courses (also known as American University undergraduate courses), American University Masters courses and even for American University PhD courses or research programs.
